fails_if: resolve_scb_errata refuses disjoint [[errata.delivered]] subsets of one column, drops `native_variable_id`, or ignores `upstream` as the correction class
note: Two entries for one column (Kon / KON fold together) are allowed when their versions are disjoint. The first names its correction class in `upstream`; the second takes the default class. Both keep the native variable anchor.
